Smoky roasted chickpeas

A crisp, warmly spiced snack that also makes a lovely topping for salads.

Tiempo 35 minutesRaciones 4

Antes de empezar

Ingredientes

Marca los ingredientes a medida que avanzas.

Lo que necesitarás

  • baking tray

Manos a la obra

Pasos

1

Preheat the oven to 200 C Pat chickpeas (400 g) (cooked and drained) dry with a clean towel.

2

Toss with olive oil (1 tbsp), smoked paprika (1 tsp) and salt (0.5 tsp).

3

Spread on a baking tray and roast for 30 minutes, shaking the tray halfway through, until crisp.

4

Let cool slightly before serving.

Buena comida. Ingredientes simples. Algo que merece ser compartido.Hecho con Cooklang.
